task.title: Unit Converter
task.buildPrompt: Build a unit converter app with three tabs: Length, Weight, Temperature. Each tab has an input field, a 'from' unit dropdown, a 'to' unit dropdown, and a live-updating result. Use a clean card layout with a single accent color. No backend needed, all conversion logic client-side.

checks.description: Page loads without console errors
Default tab (Length) is visible on load
Typing '100' with from=meters, to=feet shows numeric result within 1 second
Clicking 'Weight' tab switches visible fields
Switching from/to dropdowns updates result without requiring re-typing
Result is correct for at least 3 known conversion pairs
checks.expected: at least 2/3 conversion results correct within 5%

checks.description: No layout shift or overflow when resized to 375px width
